translations.web: The prince shall go in with them when they go in. When they go out, he shall go out.
translations.bsb: When the people enter, the prince shall go in with them, and when they leave, he shall leave.
translations.kjv: And the prince in the midst of them, when they go in, shall go in; and when they go forth, shall go forth.
translations.asv: And the prince, when they go in, shall go in in the midst of them; and when they go forth, they shall go forth together.
